title: Trump offers UFC chief Dana White press secretary job
summary: On November 7, 2026, President Donald Trump extended an offer to Dana White, the president and CEO of the UFC, to become his press secretary. This unexpected proposal has drawn attention due to White's prominent role in the sports industry and his close ties to Trump. The implications of such a move could significantly impact both the political landscape and the UFC's public relations strategy.
